name: Happy Salvage
source: The main characters, Marina Nanami, and classmates Satomi Soma and Miki Yoshino were ordinary high school girls who belonged to the swimming club of their classmates who attended St. Martins Jogakuin. Believing in the words "I will pick up Marina when I grow up" in Australia with my first love partner, Wataru, who is 3 years older, while living in the dormitory of the academy with a pendant of Bloom pearls as a proof of promise I dreamed of a reunion. However, the situation changed completely after the day when Valletta was suddenly delivered to Marina from her father who had not heard for 10 years, and a suspicious devil's hand sneaked up on her. Marina and others who passed the audition for the drama "Happy Salvage" while doubting their relationship with Valletta head to Australia, where they are filmed.
translation: 七海玛莉娜与同班同学相马里美、吉野Miki，原本都是圣马丁女子学院游泳部的普通高中女生。玛莉娜曾在澳大利亚与比自己年长三岁的初恋对象Wataru约定，“等长大后，就来接玛莉娜。”她将布鲁姆珍珠吊坠当作约定的凭证，住在学院宿舍，梦想着重逢。然而，十年没有音讯的父亲，突然寄来一枚发夹，生活就此彻底改变，可疑的魔手悄然逼近。玛莉娜等人一边怀疑这一切与发夹有关，一边通过了电视剧《Happy Salvage》的试镜，前往拍摄地澳大利亚。
